node.title: Joint-owner cancellation yields a dual-domain bounded-tail split pencil
node.statement: After factoring an exact joint defect/background owner Q=DE, the determinant identity cancels canonically to AV-CU=Lambda K with deg K at most r-deg Q. Relative to one member of a fixed owner chamber, every other member has the two-generator form K0(C,V)=K(C0,V0)+T(A,U) with deg K,deg T at most r-deg Q. At top ownership this is an ordinary affine pencil of primitive core-split locators coupled to a scalar determinantal representation of the disjoint touched-petal locator.
